summary: This note describes Claridon, an unincorporated community in Marion County, Ohio, United States. It sits on Ohio State Route 95, east of Marion and between Marion and Mt. Gilead. The community is served by the River Valley Local School District.
one_line: Claridon is an unincorporated community on Ohio State Route 95 in Marion County, Ohio, served by River Valley Local School District.
